verdict.rationale: Docs confirm built-in tracing can be globally disabled via OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING=1, which addresses telemetry opt-out for the SDK's own tracing feature. However, there is no mention of broader usage-tracking/analytics collection or any explicit privacy policy on data sent to OpenAI beyond tracing. Missing for 10: documentation of any non-tracing telemetry/usage-tracking, independent confirmation the opt-out fully stops data transmission, and a clear privacy statement covering all tracking mechanisms.
